About.heading: About
About.body: Frontend engineer focused on complex B2B React/Next.js products, building scalable systems with Feature-Sliced Design, micro-frontends, and performance-first architecture for maps, commerce, and data-heavy SaaS. Experienced in AI-native frontend development, including Generative UI, MCP tools, agentic workflows, and Vercel/OpenAI SDK integrations.
About.educationDetail: Computer Engineering — Technical University of Tabriz, 2022–2027

bulut.title: Senior Frontend Developer
bulut.summary: B2B ERP company. Owner of the Route Manager, an OptimoRoute-class logistics UI.
highlights: Drove a 70% memory optimization on Route Manager while scaling it to ~94 routes / ~3,700 invoices — clustering, virtualized timelines, narrow Zustand subscriptions, and parallel OSRM.
Architected the Sale Platform Admin with an Nx monorepo and Rspack Module Federation: independent deploys, shared packages, faster incremental builds.
Split product surfaces with FSD and shared UI contracts so features ship without a props monolith.
Shipped the Customer Panel commerce flow (catalog, cart, orders) on TanStack Query with explicit cache and invalidation.
Standardized agentic AI delivery (Cursor/Claude skills, rules, plan-to-implement loops) so generated code matches FSD boundaries.
Built a company-wide icon pack package with React component support.

freelance.title: Freelance Frontend Developer
freelance.summary: Independent frontend and web development for client projects.
highlights: Built a realtime melted-gold trading platform for the Tabriz gold bazaar — live pricing and trading flows powered by WebSockets.
Shipped a full Next.js e-commerce site end-to-end: App Router, SSR/SSG product routes, cart, catalog, and checkout.
Developed investisor.com with a rich admin panel (CKEditor), SSG/SSR rendering, and Next.js Server Actions.
Owned delivery end-to-end — scope, UI implementation, and handoff of production-ready interfaces.

primeproperty.title: Senior Frontend Developer
primeproperty.summary: Istanbul real-estate agency for buying, selling, and investing in properties.
highlights: Implemented the public property platform in Next.js, structuring pages and data fetching for a large catalog.
Used SSG/SSR so thousands of properties load in seconds — pre-rendered listing and detail routes.
Added i18n so buyers and investors browse the catalog in multiple languages without separate sites.
Owned frontend delivery for listing discovery and property detail experiences.
